title: Core: scene management (add, delete, reorder, rename)
description: Implement scene management in packages/core/src/engine/scenes.ts. Functions: addScene(doc, afterIdx?), deleteScene(doc, sceneIdx), reorderScene(doc, fromIdx, toIdx), renameScene(doc, sceneIdx, name), duplicateScene(doc, sceneIdx). All immutable, return new FlashDocument. Guard: can't delete last scene. New scene has 1 layer with 1 blank keyframe. Add unit tests in packages/core/src/engine/__tests__/scenes.test.ts. Export from engine/index.ts.
